noPermission.title: Issuing is not part of your role
noPermission.body: Pick & issue needs the issuing permission at this site. Ask your team leader.

scan.label: For which work order?
scan.hint: Scan the work order's traveller, or pick it below.

empty.title: No released work order to pick for
empty.body: Nothing is waiting for materials at this site. Ask the office.

offline.choose: No network: issuing waits until it is back. The list below is this tablet's copy.
offline.held: Issuing needs the network: the stock leaves only when the office records it. Scan again when the network is back.

list.notOpen: This work order is {status}: nothing is issued to it. Ask the office.
list.notOpenShort: This work order is not open

scan.label: Scan to issue
scan.hint: A hide is issued whole by its scan. A lot or a material asks how much.

list.title: What it needs

empty.title: This work order needs no materials
empty.body: Its bill of materials plans nothing to issue. Ask the office.

reason.CR_VI_PENDING: no chromium VI result yet, cannot be issued
reason.CR_VI_FAILED: failed the chromium VI test, cannot be issued
reason.QUALITY_HOLD: on quality hold, cannot be issued

pad.title: How much of {code}?
pad.label: Quantity
pad.covered: The work order has all it needs of this. More is an over-issue: the office issues it, with a reason.
pad.onHandOnly: Only {quantity} is usable here: the rest comes later.

notStock.message: This is no hide, lot or material of this site.
notStock.fix: Scan the stock's own label, or ask your team leader.

badge.message: This badge does not open this tablet.
badge.fix: The person signed in stays. Ask your team leader.

WORK_ORDER_NOT_OPEN.message: This work order is not open: stock is issued only to a released work order.

NOT_IN_WORK_ORDER.message: This work order does not use this material.
NOT_IN_WORK_ORDER.fix: Put it back, and scan a material of the pick list.

OTHER_COLOUR.message: This work order needs this material in another colour.
OTHER_COLOUR.fix: Put it back, and take the colour of the pick list.

CR_VI_PENDING.message: This lot has no chromium VI result yet: it cannot be issued.
CR_VI_PENDING.fix: Put it back on its rack; take released stock.

CR_VI_FAILED.message: This lot failed the chromium VI test: it cannot be issued.
CR_VI_FAILED.fix: Put it back on the quarantine rack and tell your team leader.

QUALITY_HOLD.message: This lot is on quality hold: it cannot be issued.
QUALITY_HOLD.fix: Put it back on its rack; take released stock.

BLOCKED.message: This lot is blocked: it cannot be issued.
BLOCKED.fix: Put it back on the quarantine rack and tell your team leader.

REJECTED.message: This lot was rejected: it cannot be issued.
REJECTED.fix: Put it back on the quarantine rack and tell your team leader.

HIDE_USED_UP.message: This hide is used up or scrapped.
HIDE_USED_UP.fix: Take another hide of the pick list.

NOTHING_ON_HAND.message: None of this is in stock at this site.
NOTHING_ON_HAND.fix: Take another one of the pick list, or ask the office.

MORE_THAN_ON_HAND.message: Less than that is in stock at this site.
MORE_THAN_ON_HAND.fix: Issue what is on hand; the office sees the rest is missing.

OVER_ISSUE.message: The work order has all it needs of this.
OVER_ISSUE.fix: More is an over-issue: the office issues it, with a reason.

NOT_LAST_ACTION.message: This is not your last action any more: it cannot be undone here.
NOT_LAST_ACTION.fix: Ask the office to reverse it.

NOT_AT_WORK_ORDER.message: This work order does not hold that.
NOT_AT_WORK_ORDER.fix: Scan a hide or a lot of the list, or tap a row.

MORE_THAN_AT_WORK_ORDER.message: That is more than the work order holds and has not cut.

NOTHING_AT_WORK_ORDER.message: The work order holds none of this any more.
NOTHING_AT_WORK_ORDER.fix: Read the list again: another tablet may have returned it.

return.nothing: Nothing of this work order can come back
return.lead: What work order {workOrder} holds and has not used goes back to stock. A cut hide comes back as a remnant with its area.
return.title: What can come back

scan.label: Scan what comes back
scan.hint: Scan the hide's tag or the lot's label, or tap a row.

empty.title: Nothing to return
empty.body: This work order holds nothing that was not cut or used.

pad.title: How much of {code} comes back?
pad.remnant: It comes back as a remnant with this area.

place.title: Where does it go?
place.none: This site has no store place: ask your team leader.

held.noPermission: Your role cannot see the store places: ask your team leader.
held.unavailable: The store places could not be read: try again.

place.tagNext: Then print the remnant's new tag with its area.

held.offline: Returning needs the network: it waits until it is back.

done.remnant: Back to stock as a remnant: {code} · {quantity} → {place}.

return.keepsLabel: It keeps its label: no new one is needed.

tag.title: The remnant's new tag

on.site: Prints on the site's label printer: {printer}.

tag.noPrinter: No label printer at this site: write {area} on the hide's tag.
tag.notOurs: This hide's tag is an older code that is not printed here: write {area} on it.
tag.noRight: Your role prints no labels: write {area} on the hide's tag, or ask the warehouse.
tag.name: Hide tag {code}
